T-217 is in review. Most of it had already landed on main with T-123 (5bde29e), so my change on branch `tantra-campaign-import` (f0b5528, pushed) is small.

decisions.decision: Build T-217 on branch tantra-campaign-import and fold T-236 into it (close T-236 as a duplicate). In cloud/funnel/worker.js, replace sendEmailsTantra and the /emails/batch path. The model: one single-step Omnichannel campaign per reminder touch (email, WhatsApp or LinkedIn), with the sending window open every day and every hour. The scheduler enrols each registrant with POST /email-campaigns/:id/contacts when that touch is due. Reuse the tn()/tantraUrl/tantraHeaders patterns from jobs-tantra.ts and T-234's enrolment code (main 517574e), and retry on 409. Delete TANTRA_NOTE, TANTRA_WAIT and the 'not built' line in jobs-day2.ts, and the /emails/batch contract test. Remove any Twilio WhatsApp path. Rewrite the d2 reminder cards in card-education.ts and the playbook/guide wording so nothing says Tantra sending is pending. Add the import route to vendor-sim.py and move probe-email-stripe to the import model, asserting the test registrant gets enrolled. Mark tantra-reminder-endpoint.md and the memory tantra-reminder-endpoint-pending superseded. Use only the simulator or test contacts. Then post the READY line.
decisions.why: Adi's model (google-and-reminder-model, 2026-10-07) says reminders run on live Tantra campaigns fed by import. The import route is already confirmed (integrations-tantra-api.md section 5, PR #142), and T-234 already built the same pattern. T-236 is the same work. No input from Adi is needed.

decisions.decision: Close out T-217; do not rebuild. Integrator: merge branch tantra-campaign-import (f0b5528) into main, push, deploy the centre Worker, publish the mirror, and append the DEPLOYED line with the Worker version to /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md. Then verify on main: (1) git grep for TANTRA_NOTE, TANTRA_WAIT and 'per-contact send' in cloud/src and app/src returns nothing; (2) the d2 reminder cards in card-education.ts and the playbook/guides say nothing about Tantra sending being pending, and fix any leftover wording in the same merge; (3) probe-tantra-reminders and the funnel probe pass against the simulator, asserting the test registrant is enrolled via POST /email-campaigns/:id/contacts; (4) a live centre test run on a test attendee with a simulator-connected mailbox shows reminder email as pass. A held email with no mailbox connected must read as a setup step, not 'not built'. Twilio WhatsApp removal stays with T-264. Log the results and move T-217 to review.
